run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:32:28Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert reflects failures of frontend's ad dependency, not a frontend fault. frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increases were 0 at every evaluation from 01:08:28 through 01:30:28, first became nonzero at 01:32:28 (148.4 per 10m) and peaked at 2131.6 at 01:40:28; the 1-minute series is 0 through 01:31:00 and 282 at 01:32:00. Those error spans are confined to the client operation grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, the /api/data route and tcp.connect, while frontend's CartService and CheckoutService calls show 0 errors. The ad pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has restartCount 4 with last termination OOMKilled/exit 137 (finished 01:33:42Z), a current container state also OOMKilled/exit 137 (finished 01:34:44Z), a BackOff event 'Back-off restarting failed container ad' with count 23 (lastTimestamp 01:39:21Z), only a notReadyAddresses entry in the ad Service endpoints, and ad span volume fell to 0 from 01:34:00 onward (2-minute increase) and 0 at 01:40:00 and 01:45:00 (5-minute increase). The fault is injected by chaos-mesh: the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned StressChaos objects from 01:30:33Z, and their events record 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 01:30:33, 01:31:33, 01:32:33, 01:33:33, 01:34:34 and 01:37:23, then 'Failed ... no running task found' for container IDs that had just been OOM-killed. No rollout occurred (single ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 since 00:54:04Z, unchanged 2.1.3-ad image, same pod name) and all other 20 otel-demo pods show restartCount 0. Conclusion is partial because the Schedule object's spec and creation time could not be read and the alert rule definition returned no data.

claims.text: frontend ERROR-span increase over 10 minutes was 0 at the evaluations from 01:08:28 through 01:30:28, then 148.4 at 01:32:28, rising to 2131.6 at 01:40:28 and 1909.4 at 01:42:28; the 1-minute increase series is 0 at every point from 01:25:00 to 01:31:00 and 282 at 01:32:00.

At the 01:40:00 evaluation, the span_name breakdown of frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR increases (10m) is GET 528.4, GET /api/data 528.4, executing api route (pages) /api/data 528.4, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 528.4 and tcp.connect 17.9, while grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, POST /api/cart and POST /api/checkout are all 0.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in namespace otel-demo has restartCount 4; its lastState.terminated is reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, startedAt 2026-11-18T01:33:12Z, finishedAt 2026-11-18T01:33:42Z, and its current container state is also terminated/OOMKilled, exitCode 137, startedAt 01:34:33Z, finishedAt 01:34:44Z; pod phase is Running and its ownerReference is ReplicaSet ad-554b849958.

The otel-demo Pod event for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has reason BackOff and message 'Back-off restarting failed container ad in pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5_otel-demo(bbcdfffc-b131-4200-aed7-3c00e7500006)', count 23, lastTimestamp 2026-11-18T01:39:21Z; the pod's Created/Pulled/Started events have count 6 and lastTimestamp 01:36:13Z.

The Service endpoints object named ad in namespace otel-demo has no ready addresses: its only subset lists pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (ip 100.96.2.230, port 8080) under notReadyAddresses, whereas the other otel-demo endpoints (cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, otel-collector, etc.) list ready addresses.

ad span volume collapsed: the 2-minute STATUS_CODE_UNSET increase fell to 50.67 at 01:33:00 and is 0 at every point from 01:34:00 through 01:42:00, and the 5-minute UNSET increase is 662.2 at 01:30:00, 167.8 at 01:35:00, 0 at 01:40:00 and 0 at 01:45:00.

Chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned new objects at 2026-11-18T01:30:33Z (jw6mq), 01:31:33Z (7n9mk), 01:32:33Z (8b272), 01:33:33Z (sh425), 01:34:33Z (w8tqb), 01:37:23Z (w98sl) and 01:38:18Z (9ncrx), and its Forbid events at 01:36:33Z, 01:37:33Z, 01:38:18Z, 01:38:33Z and 01:38:46Z state the previous StressChaos was still running.

StressChaos events for those spawned objects record 'Applied / Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 01:30:33Z (jw6mq), 01:31:33Z (7n9mk), 01:32:33Z (8b272), 01:33:33Z (sh425), 01:34:34Z (w8tqb) and 01:37:23Z (w98sl), and later 'Failed to apply chaos: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = no running task found: task a72e9cb865226abb627d4ded10caef357cc237fad20dcc694bfc34774d5008f7' (and the same for task baa263fb0d7c69b148f1e9be311df058aef67b2f43837ef48d898ca5a54fce5d and task 4d3410022b766c3ecdf49e6aed83d16bb4492c0d17ef5551d6c3aebbc8fb312f) — container IDs that had just been OOM-killed.
Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has replicas 1 and runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with resources requests cpu 10m / memory 225Mi and limits cpu 50m / memory 450Mi.

Only one ReplicaSet exists for component ad: ad-554b849958, created 2026-11-18T00:54:04Z, owned by Deployment ad, running the 2.1.3-ad image; pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 was created at 00:54:04Z under that ReplicaSet, so the container restarted in place rather than being replaced by a rollout.

All other 20 otel-demo pods are phase Running with restartCount 0, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx (running since 00:54:06Z) and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6 (running since 00:54:08Z); only ad-554b849958-l9ft5 shows restarts.

The ad container's logs show normal request handling ('Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.') up to 2026-11-18T01:30:33Z, which is the last timestamp in the fetched stream of pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5; no previous-container stream was available.

Before the deviation, per-service 10-minute ERROR increases for ad, fraud-detection and recommendation were about one span per window (ad 1.05 at 01:21:28-01:30:28; fraud-detection 1.05 at 01:21:28 and 1.15 at 01:48:28; recommendation 1.05-1.07 across 01:18:28-01:45:28), while accounting and payment stayed 0 and frontend went from 0 to ~1,900-2,100 per window.

The changes seen in namespace data-recorders are a separate workload and precede the ad/frontend onset: Job Completed/SuccessfulCreate events, PersistentVolumeClaim Provisioning/ExternalProvisioning/WaitForFirstConsumer events, Pod FailedScheduling with message 'running PreBind plugin "VolumeBinding": Operation cannot be fulfilled on persistentvolumeclaims ...' at 01:12:22Z and 01:13:16Z, and a PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete 'persistentvolume pvc-25b40b4b-3204-4bd5-aa5b-b336dc209e8d is still attached to node i-0ada79323930d32f6' at 01:16:39Z.

ad's own STATUS_CODE_ERROR span increase stayed at about 1 per window (1.33 at 01:31:00 and 01:32:00, 1.11 at 01:35:00, 0 at 01:40:00 and 01:45:00) while ad was being OOM-killed and then stopped emitting spans, so ad's near-zero error spans are not evidence of health; its failures appear on the caller's client spans (frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect).

Rejected that the frontend workload itself is the fault: frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx has restartCount 0, has a ready address in the frontend Service endpoints, and its ERROR spans are limited to the AdService/GetAds client operation, the /api/data route and tcp.connect, with 0 errors on its CartService and CheckoutService calls.

Rejected that an ad rollout or configuration change explains the ad failure: exactly one ad ReplicaSet (ad-554b849958) exists since 00:54:04Z with the unchanged 2.1.3-ad image and the pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 was not recreated, so the mechanism is an in-place container restart (OOMKilled), not a rollout.

The frontend-proxy error spans are most plausibly the proxy-side view of the same failing /api/data requests served by frontend; a parent-child linkage between the two was not verified because no traces were returned for this window.

ad calls were likely already failing between 01:31:00 and 01:32:00 (first nonzero frontend ERROR minute), before the earliest visible OOMKill finish time 01:33:42Z; because the pod shows restartCount 4, earlier restarts existed whose timestamps are not visible, so the memory stress plausibly degraded ad before the first recorded kill.

Human follow-up: read and then suspend or remove the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh (or make its stressors, target and duration explicit), confirm ad-554b849958 stops being OOMKilled, and then confirm frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans return to zero; consider raising the ad container's 450Mi memory limit only if stress-free operation approaches it.

gaps: The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress object itself could not be read (chaos-mesh custom resources are not among the permitted kinds), so its stressors, size, mode, duration, selector and creation time are unknown; only its events are available, hence the events-only basis for naming it.

list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned status no_data (no rule matched), so the alert's exact PromQL expression, threshold and evaluation window are unknown and the annotation's current value 2.622222222222222 could not be reproduced from a rule.

Jaeger returned no data for service frontend in 01:20:00-01:49:48 and for service ad in 01:28:00-01:45:00, so the exact gRPC status of the failed oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls and any parent-child call edge are unknown.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned no data, both with and without an error filter, so there is no frontend application-log evidence for the failing /api/data requests.

The ad container log stream ends at 01:30:33Z and the previous-container stream was unavailable ('previous terminated container "ad" in pod "ad-554b849958-l9ft5" not found'); that log view is also marked incomplete, so ad output between 01:30:33Z and the OOM kills is unknown.
Only the most recent container termination is visible on the ad pod, so the timestamps of the other OOM terminations among the 4 restarts are unknown.

No kube_* metric series exist in this Prometheus (queries for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready returned no data), so the ad deployment's ready/available replica trend cannot be shown from metrics.

Queries for networkpolicies and resourcequotas in namespace otel-demo returned no data; an empty result only shows those queries matched nothing and does not establish that such objects are absent or irrelevant.

The data-recorders namespace changes (Job/PVC churn, two Pod FailedScheduling VolumeBinding retries at 01:12:22Z and 01:13:16Z, PersistentVolume VolumeFailedDelete at 01:16:39Z) were not investigated further and are not placed as impact of this cause.
Chaos-mesh events in the authorized window begin at 01:30:33Z; whether the Schedule or other experiments existed or ran earlier cannot be determined because older events may have expired.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress spec (stressors, size, duration, mode, selector) with access to chaos-mesh custom resources and confirm whether it is still active.
Suspend or remove the otel-demo-ad-memory-stress Schedule and watch ad pod restarts and frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans for recovery.
Load the RequestErrorRate alerting rule definition to confirm the expression behind the reported current value 2.622222222222222.
Retrieve frontend and ad traces, and the ad previous-container logs, for 01:30:00-01:40:00 to capture the exact gRPC status of the failed GetAds calls.
